title: Day 721 — Five Newborns Die at IMSS Hospital in Durango; Sheinbaum Orders Investigation as Robledo Travels to Site
detail: At her September 22, 2026 (Day 721, Tuesday) mañanera, President Sheinbaum confirmed that five newborns died between September 15 and 19 in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit of Hospital General de Zona No. 1 (IMSS) in Durango, and that IMSS Director General Zoé Robledo had traveled to the state to lead the investigation and stay in contact with the affected families — "se está haciendo una investigación para ver qué fue lo que lo provocó y estar en contacto con las familias." IMSS said an initial clinical and epidemiological probe identified a bacteria sensitive to antibiotics already available at the hospital, but stressed its presence alone does not explain the five deaths; the facility has since isolated cases, restricted new NICU admissions, carried out deep cleaning and disinfection, and run contact tracing and cultures that have so far come back negative. IMSS-Bienestar director Alejandro Svarch traveled separately to Veracruz the same day to address medical-staff protests over medicine and supply shortages. Elsewhere at the conference, Anticorruption and Good Governance Secretary Raquel Buenrostro reported 4,193 public servants sanctioned since the administration began (for offenses including falsified documents and sexual harassment) and 286 companies fined a combined 147.3 million pesos, plus pension-eligibility corrections ('pensiones doradas') expected to save roughly 2.5 billion pesos annually; the Security Cabinet said 2,654 people have been arrested for fuel theft since October 2024 with no Pemex personnel implicated; and Sheinbaum urged residents of Jalisco, Colima and Michoacán to stay alert to Hurricane Polo, which forecasters expected to track offshore along the Pacific coast without making direct landfall.

media.caption: IMSS director Zoé Robledo travels to Durango after five newborns die in the hospital's neonatal ICU
Sheinbaum confirms an investigation into the deaths of five newborns at an IMSS hospital in Durango

title: Day 721 — Trump Tells UN Mexico Is 'Epicenter' of Cartel Violence, Vows 'Unmatched Military Might'
detail: Addressing the UN General Assembly on September 22, 2026, President Trump said Mexico is the "epicenter" of cartel violence that "must reclaim control of its soil from the enemies of humanity," cast drug cartels as "the ISIS of the Western Hemisphere," and called it "unacceptable" for the United States to share a 2,000-mile border with territory he described as "controlled by enemy cartels." Rallying his 'Shield of the Americas' coalition of regional allies, Trump pledged "unmatched military might" against threats in the hemisphere and urged member nations to formally designate 24 criminal organizations as narco-terrorists and apply "crushing sanctions" against them, while also saying he was "proud" of a "very good relationship with the Mexican government" and the "great steps" taken together. The remarks extend Trump's escalating rhetoric on Mexican cartels following Secretary of State Marco Rubio's earlier 'ungoverned territories' comments and the administration's cartel Foreign Terrorist Organization designation.

media.caption: Trump addresses the UN General Assembly, calling Mexico the 'epicenter' of cartel violence
